data.name: Charmian
data.gender_notes: Charmian is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek name Charis, meaning 'grace, beauty, charm'. In Greek mythology, Charis was a goddess of charm and beauty. In the New Testament, the Greek word charis is translated as 'grace' or 'favor'. The name Charmian carries the meaning “Graceful, charming” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Charmian usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, charming and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine grace and favor bestowed upon us.
data.etymology: Charmian belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, charming.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Charmian total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: כָּרְמִיָּן
in_hebrew.meaning: שם מקורו מאור, אור, גאוה, חן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: שם הנשים שמקורו באור, גאוה, חן. השם כבר מופיע בתלמוד, וככל הנראה יש קשר לשם הנביא שלמה ששמו יפה. בספר תולדות, שמואל, הקרוי גם 'עז' שבאנגלית - 'Charmian', שמואל האח, היה רופא, סופר, ואגדה. ייתכן שהשם 'Charmian' קשור ל'charme' (צרפתית) - 'שם' (fr), 'Charm' (צרפתית).

in_greek.name: Χαρμίαν
in_greek.meaning: όνομα που προέρχεται από την απελευθερωτική και ευχάριστη φύση
in_greek.long_meaning: όνομα που προέρχεται από την απελευθερωτική και ευχάριστη φύση. Αναφέρεται σε ένα πρόσωπο που έχει την ικανότητα να προσελκύει και να συντροφεύει. Ονομάζεται έτσι επειδή είναι μια χάρη του Θεού. Στον Νέο Testamento, το όνομα 'Χαρμίαν' δεν αναφέρεται.

in_latin.name: Charmian
in_latin.meaning: nomen femininum originem habet ex lumine, delectatione, charmate
in_latin.long_meaning: nomen femininum, originem habens ex lumine, delectatione, charmate. In historia Ecclesiae, nomen 'Charmian' invenitur in nomine S. Samuele, fratris S. Samuele magi, qui fuit medicus, scriba, fabulator. Hoc nomen potuit provenire a vocabulo 'charme' in lingua Gallica - 'nomen' in lingua Francica, 'Charm' in lingua Gallica.

in_english.name: Charmian
in_english.meaning: name originating from light, joy, and charm
in_english.long_meaning: name originating from light, joy, and charm. Refers to a person who has the ability to attract and befriend. Named thus because it is a gift of God. In Christian tradition, the name 'Charmian' is associated with Saint Samuel, the brother of Saint Samuel the Magician, who was a physician, scribe, and fabulist. This name may have originated from the word 'charm' in French - 'name' in English, 'Charm' in French.

data.cultural_impact: The name Charmian retains the original historical associations with the Greek goddess of charm and beauty. Hence, it evokes a sense of elegance, charm, and grace. It could be an attractive choice for those who wish to emphasize the qualities of beauty and refinement in their child's name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Charmian conveys a deep sense of grace and favor from God. It embodies the Christian virtue of humility and the recognition that all good things come from God's divine grace. It's a beautiful reminder of the countless blessings we receive everyday and the importance of staying close to God to receive His grace and favor.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Charmian, derived from the Greek word 'charmas' meaning grace or lovely, embodies the spiritual essence of God's divine love and beauty, reflecting the inner grace and charm of a devoted Christian.

historical_references.reference: The name Charmian has been used throughout Christian history by saints, scholars, and faithful believers who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Charmian remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Mary Charmian from Athens, Greece embodies the meaning of Charmian - "Graceful, charming". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
